notes.title: [AshBall DevLog #2] Matchmaking System and Improvements
notes.content:
⚡ Quick Match: Getting into the game is now easier than ever!🔥

This week I’ve added a brand-new feature to get you into matches faster: the Matchmaking System.  
The game will first scan for available sessions; if it can’t find one, it will automatically create a new session for you. All you need to do is press the Start button — the system takes care of the rest.  
Faster matches, more chaos.


Other improvements in this update:


Improved connection stability ⚡
Performance improvements and small optimizations 🛠️
Several bug fixes and balance tweaks 🔧

I’m still working to make the game more fun, intense, and unpredictable than what you saw in the trailer.  
Weekly updates will continue to bring small but impactful changes.


Thanks for your interest and patience — we’re just getting started!

And yes I still need an artist. Please contact me 😭😭 ( 8kyaoo@gmail.com )

notes.title: [AshBall DevLog #1 There is a Spirit in the Menu – UI Update & Minor Fixes
notes.content:
🔧 A Small Touch: The Menu Feels More Alive! 🔥

Hello there!



Lately, I've been working on Blender, UI animation, and post-processing in Unity.

I've slowly started integrating what I learn into AshBall.



In this update:


  The menu title now has a typewriter animation (with an actual typewriter sound while typing 🖋️🎹)
  The Leaderboard button is now animated with a small "fire" effect that fits the lava theme
  Some old UI elements were simplified for a cleaner and more balanced look
  Post-processing adjustments were made for better tone harmony in the background
  A rare synchronization bug related to ball sharing was fixed


These may be small, but they add soul.

AshBall is still alive, learning, and growing 🍂🔥



Thanks!

notes.title: Update Incoming – It’s Gonna Be Intense!
notes.content:
